meta.name: Thursdays Widows
meta.description:
Teresa finds her husband and his two best friends dead in the lavish community where they live. As the truth comes to light, so will dark secrets.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: They Must Know the Truth
videos.overview: Two teens snoop on private — and even perverse — occurrences within the community. Tano pressures the new tenant and is later bitterly surprised.

videos.title: The Scaglia Family
videos.overview: Tano's troubles at work are disclosed — all while Teresa brags about her family's future. A snarky remark and a suspicious phone call rattle Mavi.

videos.title: The Andrade Family
videos.overview: Various facets of Mariana's personality are revealed, including her frustrations with Ernesto — and Ramona's frustrations with her.

videos.title: The De La Luna Family
videos.overview: Martín's downfall begins with a fateful turn in his political career, plunging him and Lala into uncomfortable situations — financially and beyond.

videos.title: The Maldonado Family
videos.overview: Carla receives a dire warning from Rosa, accompanied by unexpected news. The pivotal decisions she makes — and Gustavo's true colors — are unveiled.

videos.title: The Guevara Family
videos.overview: Mavi's fears come to the surface. As a shocking text message makes waves, the wives must consider abandoning their idyllic bubble... or doubling the bet.
